title.narrative: 1.MATERNAL NEWBORN AND CHILD HEALTH

description.narrative: By the end of 2025, children under 5, women of childbearing age including adolescents and pregnant women, in the most disadvantaged regions, have increased access to integrated quality maternal, newborn and child health services, taking into account prevention through vaccination and the management of HIV infection at institutional and community levels, including in emergency situations, and taking into account the triple nexus.
